meta_description:
4,808 likes, 44 comments - beebomco on October 8, 2026: "5 Best Deals On Snapdragon-Powered Phones! 🔥

If you’re planning to upgrade your smartphone this festive season, it is worth picking one powered by Snapdragon. From the CPU, GPU and NPU to the ISP for cameras, Snapdragon delivers across the board, and Qualcomm builds some of the world’s fastest mobile CPUs.

The vivo V80 is newly launched and powered by the Snapdragon 7 Gen 4. It is a camera-centric phone, and the Spectra ISP enables AI-enhanced image processing along with 4K 60 FPS video recording. It has a ZEISS triple camera setup with a telephoto lens, a sharp AMOLED display and a 7200mAh battery. It will be available for ₹XX,XXX during the sale.

The OnePlus Nord 6 runs on the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4. The Adreno GPU supports Call of Duty at native 165 FPS, and in our testing the battery life is among the best in its segment. The phone gets a discount of ₹4,000 and is available for ₹42,999.

The Nothing Phone 4a is powered by the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4. A new variant with 6GB RAM is now available, starting at ₹32,999. It has a premium design and offers well-rounded performance for the price.

The Motorola Edge 70 Fusion is the pick for buyers with a budget under ₹30,000. It runs on the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4, which keeps the user experience smooth and the battery efficient, and it comes with a capable camera setup. It will sell for ₹29,999 during the sale.

The Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy. It comes with a Privacy Display, a quad camera setup and a built-in S Pen. During the sale, it is available with a discount of ₹20,000.".
